text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour and Social Affairs Ministry signs a one million dinar deal to build a training centre in the country.
- Bahrain, Morocco discuss a draft agreement on cooperation in judicial issues.
- French exports to Bahrain rose to $106.5 million in 1996 from $75.3 million in 1995.
- Bahrain launches industrial award. Firms operating in Bahrain are urged to compete on productivity, quality and giving more jobs to Bahrainis.
- Kuwait starts questioning a group of "Hizbollah-Gulf", including 11 Bahrainis and other Arab members. The group was accused of planning sabotage actions against Kuwait's security.
- Bahrain affirms intention to boost its cooperation with U.S. oil firm Chevron. Bahrain has signed a letter of intent to buy Chevron's 40 percent stake in Bahrain refinery from April 1.
